words.enDefinition: A proposal to employ someone in a particular role

examples.en: I received a job offer from the library just before the new term began.
examples.zh: 新学期快开始时，我收到了图书馆的「录用通知」。

examples.en: The job offer listed the department and the hours for each weekend shift.
examples.zh: 「录用通知」列出了所属部门和每个周末班次的工作时长。

words.enDefinition: An offer communicated by speaking instead of writing

examples.en: I got a verbal offer over the phone while I was walking home from class.
examples.zh: 我下课走回家的路上接到电话，收到了「口头录用通知」。

examples.en: The manager made a verbal offer and said the written details would follow that afternoon.
examples.zh: 经理发出了「口头录用通知」，说当天下午会发来书面细节。

collocations: confirm a verbal offer in writing

words.enDefinition: An offer communicated in writing

examples.en: The written offer arrived the morning after my call with the library manager.
examples.zh: 我和图书馆经理通话后的第二天早上，「书面录用通知」就发来了。

examples.en: I checked the hours in the written offer against what we'd discussed by phone.
examples.zh: 我把「书面录用通知」里的工时和电话里谈过的工时对照了一下。

words.enDefinition: A letter formally stating the details of an offer

examples.en: The offer letter gave the expected start date and the name of my supervisor.
examples.zh: 「录用函」写明了预计到岗日期和我主管的姓名。

examples.en: I uploaded my signed offer letter to the same page where I'd applied.
examples.zh: 我把签好的「录用函」上传到当初申请岗位的那个页面。

words.enDefinition: An offer that is not yet fully confirmed

examples.en: The university sent me a provisional offer while it checked my preferred start date.
examples.zh: 学校在核对我希望的到岗日期期间，先发来一份「暂定录用通知」。

examples.en: I asked which details on the provisional offer still needed to be confirmed.
examples.zh: 我问「暂定录用通知」上哪些细节还需要确认。

words.enDefinition: An offer with no outstanding requirements to meet

examples.en: The library issued an unconditional offer once it had all the information it needed.
examples.zh: 图书馆拿到所需的全部信息后，发出了「无附加条件的录用通知」。

examples.en: I asked whether the email was an unconditional offer or whether any checks were outstanding.
examples.zh: 我问邮件是「无附加条件的录用通知」，还是有审核没完成。

words.enDefinition: Details setting out what an employer is offering

examples.en: I read the offer terms again after noticing the start date in the attachment.
examples.zh: 注意到附件里的到岗日期后，我又读了一遍「录用条款」。

examples.en: The revised offer terms listed a different work location from the one we first discussed.
examples.zh: 修订后的「录用条款」写的工作地点和我们最初谈的不一样。

words.enDefinition: Requirements that must be met for the offer

examples.en: The portal listed the offer conditions at the top of the page in bold.
examples.zh: 门户把「录用前须满足的条件」用粗体列在页面顶部。

examples.en: I checked whether the offer conditions had changed after my references were sent.
examples.zh: 推荐材料发出后，我查看了「录用条件」是否有变化。

words.zhGloss: 以推荐人核查通过为条件
words.enDefinition: Depending on satisfactory references about the applicant
acceptedZhAnswers: 以推荐人核查通过为条件

examples.en: The offer was subject to references, so the library asked for my former supervisor's details.
examples.zh: 录用「以推荐人核查通过为条件」，所以图书馆要了我前任主管的联系方式。

examples.en: The letter said the post was subject to references from my two most recent employers.
examples.zh: 信中写明，这份工作「以最近两家雇主提供的推荐信息通过核查为条件」。

words.enDefinition: Dependent on approval before being confirmed

examples.en: The start date was subject to approval because the department was changing its term schedule.
examples.zh: 部门在调整学期安排，所以到岗日期「须经批准」。

examples.en: The manager said the extra hours were subject to approval from the department head.
examples.zh: 经理说，额外工时「须经部门负责人批准」。

collocations: a start date subject to approval

words.enDefinition: While checks on an applicant are still outstanding

examples.en: The letter said my offer was still pending background checks before the start date.
examples.zh: 信上说，我的录用还要「等待背景核查完成」，才能按计划到岗。

examples.en: The offer remained pending background checks when I opened the portal again on Monday.
examples.zh: 周一再打开门户时，录用状态仍显示「等待背景核查完成」。

words.enDefinition: To do what an offer requires before confirmation

examples.en: The letter explained what I needed to provide to meet the conditions of the offer.
examples.zh: 录用函说明我需要提供什么才能「满足所列条件」。

examples.en: I asked how long I had to meet the conditions stated in the email.
examples.zh: 我问自己有多少时间「满足邮件中列出的条件」。

collocations: be able to meet the conditions

words.enDefinition: An offer with changes to its earlier details

examples.en: The revised offer reflected the new start date we had agreed on by phone.
examples.zh: 「修改后的录用通知」写入了我们电话里商定的新到岗日期。

examples.en: I received a revised offer after pointing out that the office location was incorrect.
examples.zh: 我指出办公地点有误后，收到了一份「修改后的录用通知」。

words.enDefinition: A different offer that the same candidate is considering

examples.en: I mentioned the competing offer when the library asked how soon I could decide.
examples.zh: 图书馆问我多快能决定时，我提到了「另一份录用通知」。

examples.en: The theatre's offer deadline was earlier than the one on my competing offer.
examples.zh: 剧院录用通知的回复截止时间比「我收到的另一份录用通知」更早。

words.enDefinition: To propose hiring someone for a job

examples.en: The manager said they hoped to make an offer before the end of the week.
examples.zh: 经理说，他们希望本周结束前「发出录用通知」。

examples.en: The university needed to check the opening was funded before it could make an offer.
examples.zh: 学校得先确认这个岗位有经费，才能「发出录用通知」。

collocations: be ready to make an offer
make an offer to a candidate

words.enDefinition: To agree to take the job offered

examples.en: Can I accept an offer through the portal or do I need to reply directly?
examples.zh: 我能通过门户「接受录用通知」吗，还是需要直接回复？

examples.en: I took a day to accept an offer because I wanted to confirm the hours.
examples.zh: 我想确认工时，所以隔了一天才「接受录用通知」。

collocations: be ready to accept an offer

words.enDefinition: To say that one will not take the offered job

examples.en: I had to decline an offer after learning the hours clashed with my classes.
examples.zh: 发现工时和上课时间冲突后，我不得不「谢绝录用通知」。

examples.en: Did you decline an offer in the portal or reply to the manager's email?
examples.zh: 你是在门户里「谢绝录用通知」的，还是回了经理的邮件？

words.enDefinition: To give an employer a reply about an offer

examples.en: The portal explained how to respond to an offer from a university department.
examples.zh: 门户说明了如何「回复大学一个部门发出的录用通知」。

examples.en: I asked whether I could respond to an offer by email before the portal closed.
examples.zh: 我问能不能在门户关闭前用邮件「回复录用通知」。

collocations: respond to an offer by email
time to respond to an offer

words.enDefinition: The latest time an offer can be accepted

examples.en: I noted the acceptance deadline while reading the message on my way to class.
examples.zh: 上课路上看消息时，我记下了「接受录用的截止时间」。

examples.en: What time zone does the acceptance deadline use for candidates who currently live abroad?
examples.zh: 目前住在海外的求职者，要按哪个时区计算「接受录用的截止时间」？

words.enDefinition: The employer is still accepting a response

examples.en: The message says the offer remains open until Monday, even though the office closes today.
examples.zh: 消息说，虽然办公室今天关门，这份「录用通知的有效期到周一」。

examples.en: Could you confirm whether the offer remains open while the start date is being discussed?
examples.zh: 在讨论到岗日期期间，能否确认这份「录用通知仍有效」？

collocations: the offer remains open until Friday
confirm that the offer remains open
the offer remains open for another week

words.enDefinition: An offer no longer open because time ran out

examples.en: The portal displayed an expired offer when I checked the application after the holiday.
examples.zh: 假期后查看申请时，门户显示这份「录用通知已失效」。

examples.en: I asked whether an expired offer would still appear in my application history.
examples.zh: 我问「已失效的录用通知」是否仍会出现在申请历史记录里。

collocations: an expired offer in the portal
an expired offer cannot be accepted

words.enDefinition: An employer has taken back its offer

examples.en: The status changed to Offer withdrawn after the department cancelled the weekend position.
examples.zh: 部门取消周末岗位后，状态变成了「录用通知已撤回」。

examples.en: I saw Offer withdrawn in the portal and contacted the department to ask what happened.
examples.zh: 我在门户看到「录用通知已撤回」，就联系部门询问情况。

words.enDefinition: To let an employer know its offer was received

examples.en: I wanted to acknowledge an offer before I had time to read the attachment properly.
examples.zh: 我还没时间仔细读附件，想先「确认收到录用通知」。

examples.en: The portal lets me acknowledge an offer before I decide whether to accept it.
examples.zh: 门户允许我先「确认收到录用通知」，再决定要不要接受。

collocations: acknowledge an offer without accepting it

words.enDefinition: A written response agreeing to take an offer

examples.en: My written acceptance included the start date that we'd discussed on the phone.
examples.zh: 我在「书面确认接受录用」时写明了电话里谈过的到岗日期。

examples.en: I saved a copy of my written acceptance alongside the offer letter from the library.
examples.zh: 我把「书面确认接受录用」的副本和图书馆发来的录用函放在一起。

words.zhGloss: 在门户上确认接受录用
words.enDefinition: To agree to an offer using the employer's website
acceptedZhAnswers: 在门户上确认接受录用

examples.en: The university asked me to accept through the portal instead of responding by email.
examples.zh: 学校让我「在门户上确认接受录用」，不用回邮件。

examples.en: Can I accept through the portal today and sign the letter on Monday?
examples.zh: 我今天能先「在门户上确认接受录用」，周一再签录用函吗？

collocations: choose to accept through the portal
be able to accept through the portal
applicants can accept through the portal

words.enDefinition: To request a later time to respond

examples.en: I wanted to ask for more time because I hadn't received my exam schedule yet.
examples.zh: 我还没收到考试安排，所以想「请求多给一些时间」。

examples.en: Could I ask for more time to check the new hours against my timetable?
examples.zh: 我能不能「请您多给一些时间」，让我核对新工时和课程表有没有冲突？

collocations: decide to ask for more time
ask for more time to decide

words.enDefinition: To allow more time to answer a job offer

examples.en: The department agreed to extend an offer deadline because the portal was temporarily unavailable.
examples.zh: 求职门户暂时无法使用，部门同意「延长录用回复期限」。

examples.en: Can the recruiter extend an offer deadline while a candidate waits for a final schedule?
examples.zh: 求职者等待最终时间表期间，招聘人员能「延长录用回复期限」吗？

collocations: agree to extend an offer deadline
request that an employer extend an offer deadline
extend an offer deadline by two days

words.enDefinition: To record an agreement or detail in writing

examples.en: The manager offered to confirm in writing that I could keep my Wednesday class.
examples.zh: 经理说可以「书面确认」我能继续上周三的课。

examples.en: Could you confirm in writing which branch I'll be working at during the summer?
examples.zh: 您能「以书面形式确认」我暑假要去哪家分店上班吗？

collocations: ask someone to confirm in writing

words.enDefinition: To examine the details before deciding about an offer

examples.en: I took the evening to review the offer once I got home from class.
examples.zh: 我下课回家后，花了一晚上「仔细查看录用内容」。

examples.en: Can I review the offer on the portal before confirming that I've received it?
examples.zh: 我能先在门户上「仔细查看录用内容」，再确认已收到吗？

collocations: take time to review the offer
a chance to review the offer

words.enDefinition: To explain what the conditions or details mean

examples.en: I asked the manager to clarify the terms because the schedule mentioned two different sites.
examples.zh: 排班表提到了两个地点，所以我请经理「澄清条款」。

examples.en: Could you clarify the terms for taking leave during the first month of work?
examples.zh: 您能把第一个月的请假「条款澄清一下」吗？

collocations: ask someone to clarify the terms
clarify the terms of an offer

words.enDefinition: To accept the stated conditions of an arrangement

examples.en: I could agree to the terms once the department confirmed my Thursday evening shift.
examples.zh: 部门确认了我周四晚的班次后，我就可以「同意所列条款」了。

examples.en: The page asked me to agree to the terms before opening the signature screen.
examples.zh: 页面要求我先「同意所列条款」，才能打开签署界面。

collocations: be willing to agree to the terms
click to agree to the terms
agree to the terms in writing

words.enDefinition: To discover priorities or views both sides share

examples.en: We managed to find common ground by discussing which evenings worked for everyone.
examples.zh: 讨论哪些晚上大家都有空之后，我们总算「找到了共同点」。

examples.en: The manager and I began to find common ground when we compared our weekly schedules.
examples.zh: 经理和我对照了各自每周的时间表后，开始「找到双方都能接受的地方」。

collocations: work together to find common ground
help both sides find common ground

words.enDefinition: To complete the agreed details of a job offer

examples.en: The manager needed the exact start date before she could finalise an offer for me.
examples.zh: 经理需要确定准确的到岗日期，才能为我「敲定录用细节」。

examples.en: Can the department finalise an offer while the work schedule is still being discussed?
examples.zh: 工作排班还在讨论的时候，部门能「敲定录用细节」吗？

collocations: be ready to finalise an offer
need approval to finalise an offer

words.enDefinition: To wait before agreeing to an offer

examples.en: I decided to hold off on accepting until I had the updated hours in writing.
examples.zh: 我决定先「暂缓接受」，等收到更新后工时的书面说明。

examples.en: Can I hold off on accepting until I know which site I'll be working at?
examples.zh: 我能先「暂缓接受」，等知道在哪个地点上班再决定吗？

collocations: decide to hold off on accepting
be able to hold off on accepting
hold off on accepting until Monday

words.enDefinition: Not open to discussion or change

examples.en: The department said the weekday closing shift was non-negotiable because nobody else could cover it.
examples.zh: 部门说，平日打烊班没人能顶替，因此「不能协商」。

examples.en: I asked which parts of the written offer were non-negotiable before we discussed hours.
examples.zh: 谈工时之前，我问书面录用通知里哪些条款是「不可协商的」。

words.enDefinition: The date someone begins work in a role

examples.en: The start date in the letter fell in the week after my last exam.
examples.zh: 信上的「到岗日期」在我最后一场考试结束后一周。

examples.en: I received a separate message about my start date after signing the offer letter.
examples.zh: 签完录用函后，我另外收到一条关于「到岗日期」的消息。

words.enDefinition: A suggested date for starting work

examples.en: The manager's proposed start date was the first Monday after the spring break.
examples.zh: 经理「拟定的到岗日期」是春假结束后的第一个周一。

examples.en: I asked whether the proposed start date could move to the following week.
examples.zh: 我问「拟定到岗日期」能不能改到下一周。

collocations: set out the proposed start date

words.enDefinition: To settle together on the first day of work

examples.en: We could finally agree on a start date once my last exam was confirmed.
examples.zh: 我的最后一场考试时间确定后，我们终于可以「商定到岗日期」了。

examples.en: Can we agree on a start date after I check my university timetable?
examples.zh: 我核对学校的课程表后，我们再「商定到岗日期」可以吗？

collocations: meet to agree on a start date
agree on a start date by phone
work with someone to agree on a start date

words.enDefinition: To move the planned first working day later

examples.en: I asked if we could push back the start date until my exam week ended.
examples.zh: 我问能不能「推迟到岗日期」，等考试周结束再上班。

examples.en: The department had to push back the start date because the building was closed for repairs.
examples.zh: 楼在封闭维修，所以部门不得不「推迟到岗日期」。

collocations: ask to push back the start date
agree to push back the start date
push back the start date by a week

words.enDefinition: To move the planned first working day earlier

examples.en: The manager asked if we could bring forward the start date to the second of July.
examples.zh: 经理问能不能「把到岗日期提前」至七月二日。

examples.en: Would it be possible to bring forward the start date now that my course has ended?
examples.zh: 现在我的课程已经结束了，能不能「把到岗日期提前」？

collocations: ask to bring forward the start date
agree to bring forward the start date
bring forward the start date by two days

words.enDefinition: The first day someone actually works in a job

examples.en: I met the rest of the library team on my first working day there.
examples.zh: 我「第一天上班」时见到了图书馆团队的其他成员。

examples.en: The message explained where to pick up my key on my first working day.
examples.zh: 消息写明了我「第一天上班」要去哪里领钥匙。

collocations: instructions for your first working day

words.enDefinition: To arrive at the workplace ready to begin

examples.en: The email told me when to report for work at the second library branch.
examples.zh: 邮件告诉我什么时候去图书馆第二分馆「报到」。

examples.en: I was asked to report for work at the front desk before nine on Monday.
examples.zh: 对方让我周一九点前到前台「报到」。

collocations: be asked to report for work

words.enDefinition: The place where a new worker should first arrive

examples.en: The letter gave a reporting location on campus rather than the branch in town.
examples.zh: 信上给的「报到地点」在校园里，不是在市区的分店。

examples.en: I checked the reporting location because the library has two entrances on different streets.
examples.zh: 图书馆的两个入口在不同街上，所以我核对了「报到地点」。

words.enDefinition: Directions for arriving at the workplace to start

examples.en: The attached reporting instructions told me which entrance to use before the office opened.
examples.zh: 所附「报到须知」告诉我办公室开门前该走哪个入口。

examples.en: I reread the reporting instructions to find the name of the person meeting me.
examples.zh: 我重读了「报到须知」，想找来接我的人的姓名。

words.enDefinition: The time a new worker is expected to arrive

examples.en: The reporting time was earlier than the start of my shift on the schedule.
examples.zh: 「报到时间」比排班表上的上班时间早。

examples.en: Could you confirm the reporting time for everyone starting at the museum next Monday?
examples.zh: 您能确认下周一在博物馆开始工作的人员的「报到时间」吗？

words.enDefinition: Plans for starting one's first day at a job

examples.en: The first-day arrangements included collecting my pass and meeting the rest of the team.
examples.zh: 「首日到岗安排」包括领通行证和与其他团队成员见面。

examples.en: I received the first-day arrangements in an email after agreeing to the new start date.
examples.zh: 商定新的到岗日期后，我收到了一封邮件，里面写了「首日到岗安排」。

words.enDefinition: The hours both sides have accepted for a job

examples.en: The letter listed the agreed working hours next to the name of the department.
examples.zh: 信把「商定的工作时间」列在部门名称旁边。

examples.en: I checked that the agreed working hours didn't overlap with my Tuesday evening class.
examples.zh: 我确认了「商定的工作时间」不和我周二的晚课冲突。

collocations: set out the agreed working hours
work beyond the agreed working hours

words.enDefinition: Discussion aimed at agreeing on pay for a job

examples.en: The salary negotiation took place after the department made its first offer by email.
examples.zh: 部门通过邮件发来初步录用通知后，双方进行了「薪资谈判」。

examples.en: I discussed my previous library work during the salary negotiation for the new role.
examples.zh: 就新岗位进行「薪资谈判」时，我谈到了之前在图书馆的工作。

words.enDefinition: To discuss changes to a job offer

examples.en: I wanted to negotiate an offer that would let me finish my Thursday evening course.
examples.zh: 我想「协商录用条件」，让自己能上完周四晚上的课。

examples.en: Can I negotiate an offer if the start date overlaps with my final exams?
examples.zh: 如果到岗日期撞上期末考试，我能「协商录用条件」吗？

collocations: be able to negotiate an offer
negotiate an offer with an employer

words.enDefinition: Flexibility to change what has been proposed

examples.en: I asked whether there was room to negotiate on the day I would start.
examples.zh: 我问到岗日期有没有「协商空间」。

examples.en: The department said there was little room to negotiate because the hours were fixed.
examples.zh: 部门说工时是固定的，所以「协商空间」很小。

words.enDefinition: The pay a candidate hopes to receive

examples.en: The hiring manager asked about my salary expectations after describing the duties of the job.
examples.zh: 招聘经理介绍完岗位职责后，问我「薪资期望」是多少。

examples.en: I asked whether I could discuss salary expectations once I knew the exact hours.
examples.zh: 我问能不能等确定具体工时后再谈「薪资期望」。

words.enDefinition: The pay set for the start of employment

examples.en: The offer letter lists a different starting salary from the one quoted on the phone.
examples.zh: 录用函列出的「起薪」和电话里报的不一样。

examples.en: I asked when the starting salary would first be reviewed by the department.
examples.zh: 我问部门什么时候会首次重新评估「起薪」。

words.enDefinition: A salary amount stated for one year

examples.en: The offer quotes an annual salary even though I would be paid every month.
examples.zh: 尽管每月发薪，录用通知写的是「年薪」。

examples.en: I found the annual salary in a separate table below the list of duties.
examples.zh: 我在职责清单下方的一张单独表格中找到了「年薪」。

words.enDefinition: A salary amount stated for one month

examples.en: The manager confirmed the monthly salary after we agreed on how many hours I'd work.
examples.zh: 我们商定工时后，经理确认了「月薪」。

examples.en: I asked whether the figure in the letter was a monthly salary or an annual amount.
examples.zh: 我问信里的数字是「月薪」还是一年的金额。

words.enDefinition: The combined value of pay and employer benefits

examples.en: The offer summary listed total compensation separately from the amount paid in cash.
examples.zh: 录用摘要把「薪酬福利总值」和现金支付金额分开列了。

examples.en: I asked whether the travel allowance was included in the total compensation figure shown.
examples.zh: 我问列出的「薪酬福利总值」里有没有算上交通补贴。

words.enDefinition: Employee benefits provided otherwise than as cash pay

examples.en: The leaflet listed free language classes among the non-cash benefits available to new staff.
examples.zh: 传单把免费语言课列入了新员工可以享受的「非现金福利」。

examples.en: I asked which non-cash benefits were included with the museum's part-time roles.
examples.zh: 我问博物馆的兼职岗位包括哪些「非现金福利」。

words.enDefinition: Pay that can change based on stated conditions

examples.en: The offer separated variable pay from the amount guaranteed for each month.
examples.zh: 录用通知把「浮动薪酬」和每月保证支付的金额分开列了。

examples.en: I asked how variable pay was calculated for staff working at different locations.
examples.zh: 我问在不同地点工作的员工，「浮动薪酬」是怎么算的。

words.enDefinition: A one-time bonus for joining an employer

examples.en: The signing bonus appeared in the offer summary below the figure for starting salary.
examples.zh: 「签约奖金」列在录用摘要中的起薪金额下方。

examples.en: I asked when the signing bonus would be paid if I accepted the offer.
examples.zh: 我问如果接受录用通知，「签约奖金」什么时候发。

words.enDefinition: A bonus the employer commits to paying

examples.en: The company confirmed the guaranteed bonus in writing before I signed the offer letter.
examples.zh: 我签录用函之前，公司书面确认了「保证发放的奖金」。

examples.en: I checked whether the guaranteed bonus was included in the first year's salary figures.
examples.zh: 我查了首年薪资金额有没有计入「保证发放的奖金」。

collocations: a guaranteed bonus for the first year

words.enDefinition: A bonus an employer may choose to pay

examples.en: The offer letter described the discretionary bonus separately from the guaranteed monthly salary.
examples.zh: 录用函把「酌情发放的奖金」和保证发放的月薪分开说明。

examples.en: I asked who decides whether to award a discretionary bonus in my department.
examples.zh: 我问我们部门由谁决定是否发放「酌情奖金」。

collocations: be eligible for a discretionary bonus

words.enDefinition: Salary adjusted to part of a full period or schedule

examples.en: The offer gave a prorated salary because the work would start halfway through April.
examples.zh: 因为四月过半才开始工作，录用通知列的是「按比例折算的薪资」。

examples.en: I asked how the prorated salary in the letter related to the full-time figure.
examples.zh: 我问信中的「按比例折算的薪资」和全职薪资金额是什么关系。

collocations: a prorated salary for part of a month

words.enDefinition: A formal look at whether pay should change

examples.en: I asked when my first pay review would be after finishing the summer term.
examples.zh: 我问暑期学期结束后，什么时候会进行第一次「薪酬复核」。

examples.en: The offer letter mentioned a pay review after the first six months of work.
examples.zh: 录用函提到，入职满六个月后会进行一次「薪酬复核」。

words.enDefinition: A designated level in an employer's pay structure

examples.en: The university assigned one pay grade to all the roles at that level.
examples.zh: 学校把那个层级的所有职位划在同一个「薪酬级别」。

examples.en: I asked where I could find the rates listed for the pay grade in the letter.
examples.zh: 我问到哪里可以查信中那个「薪酬级别」对应的薪资标准。

collocations: roles in the same pay grade

words.enDefinition: A defined range of pay for certain roles

examples.en: The library listed one pay band for assistants and another for senior assistants.
examples.zh: 图书馆为助理和高级助理分别列了不同的「薪酬档位区间」。

examples.en: I wanted to know how the starting salary fit within the pay band shown.
examples.zh: 我想知道起薪在所列「薪酬档位区间」里处于什么位置。

collocations: the top of a pay band

words.enDefinition: A specific rate within a defined pay grade

examples.en: The offer listed my pay step underneath the grade for the library assistant role.
examples.zh: 录用通知在图书馆助理职位的薪级下方列了我的「薪点」。

examples.en: I asked which pay step would apply if the university counted my previous experience.
examples.zh: 我问学校如果认可我之前的经验，会适用哪个「薪点」。

collocations: move to the next pay step
place someone on a pay step
start at the first pay step

words.enDefinition: Movement to higher levels within a pay structure

examples.en: The staff handbook explained pay progression for employees who moved up the pay scale.
examples.zh: 员工手册说明了员工如何沿薪酬等级「晋档」。

examples.en: I asked how pay progression worked for people on part-time schedules at the library.
examples.zh: 我问图书馆兼职员工的「薪酬晋档」是怎么安排的。

words.enDefinition: The typical pay for comparable work in a market

examples.en: I looked up the market rate for similar library roles in the same city.
examples.zh: 我查了同一个城市相似图书馆岗位的「市场薪资水平」。

examples.en: The adviser showed me a local survey that listed the market rate for comparable jobs.
examples.zh: 顾问给我看了一份当地的调查，里面列了类似岗位的「市场薪资水平」。

collocations: compare an offer with the market rate

words.enDefinition: The highest pay in a particular band

examples.en: The recruiter said the amount in my letter was the top of the pay band.
examples.zh: 招聘人员说，信里的金额已经是「薪酬区间上限」。

examples.en: I asked what experience was needed to start at the top of the pay band.
examples.zh: 我问要有什么经验，起薪才能达到「薪酬区间上限」。

collocations: start at the top of the pay band
reach the top of the pay band
pay at the top of the pay band

words.zhGloss: 给出同等条件的录用通知
words.enDefinition: To offer terms equal to another employer's
acceptedZhAnswers: 给出同等条件的录用通知

examples.en: The museum said it couldn't match an offer from the university library this term.
examples.zh: 博物馆说这学期无法「给出和大学图书馆同等条件的录用通知」。

examples.en: Could the department match an offer if another employer proposed a higher starting salary?
examples.zh: 如果另一家雇主给的起薪更高，系里能「给出同等条件的录用通知」吗？

collocations: be willing to match an offer

words.enDefinition: Money available for paying staff

examples.en: The manager said the pay budget would need approval before she could change the offer.
examples.zh: 经理说，要调整录用内容，得先批准「薪酬预算」。

examples.en: The department's pay budget allowed for a slightly higher starting salary than I'd expected.
examples.zh: 系里的「薪酬预算」允许给出比我预期略高的起薪。

words.enDefinition: A change to the amount of salary

examples.en: The second letter showed a salary adjustment after the department checked my previous experience.
examples.zh: 系里核查我以前的经验后，第二封信显示有一项「薪资调整」。

examples.en: I asked whether the salary adjustment would appear in the final offer before I signed.
examples.zh: 我问签署前能不能在最终录用通知里看到「薪资调整」。

words.enDefinition: To discuss changes to benefits included with a job

examples.en: I wanted to negotiate benefits because the location made the commute more expensive than expected.
examples.zh: 工作地点让通勤比预想的更贵，所以我想「协商福利」。

examples.en: Could I negotiate benefits with the department after we agreed on the starting salary?
examples.zh: 商定起薪后，我能和系里「协商福利」吗？

collocations: negotiate benefits as part of an offer

words.enDefinition: To sign a document and send it back

examples.en: The manager asked me to sign and return the offer letter before Friday afternoon.
examples.zh: 经理让我周五下午之前在录用函上「签字后交回」。

examples.en: I checked which page I needed to sign and return through the university's portal.
examples.zh: 我查了哪一页需要「签字后通过学校门户交回」。

collocations: sign and return the offer letter
sign and return the document online

words.enDefinition: To add a signature to a document already signed

examples.en: The department head needed to countersign the offer letter after I signed it.
examples.zh: 我签署录用函后，系主任还需要「再签字确认」。

examples.en: I asked who would countersign the agreement before a copy was sent back to me.
examples.zh: 我问在把副本发回给我之前，谁会在这份协议上「再签字确认」。

words.enDefinition: A copy bearing the required additional signature

examples.en: The university sent me a countersigned copy after the hiring manager signed the letter.
examples.zh: 招聘经理签完函件后，学校给我发了一份「双方已签字的副本」。

examples.en: I saved the countersigned copy in the folder with the rest of my job documents.
examples.zh: 我把「双方已签字的副本」和其他求职材料一起保存在同一个文件夹。

words.enDefinition: The latest time a document can be signed

examples.en: The signature deadline was printed at the bottom of the letter in small text.
examples.zh: 「签署截止时间」用小字印在信的最下方。

examples.en: I asked whether the signature deadline would change after the start date was revised.
examples.zh: 我问到岗日期改了之后，「签署截止时间」会不会变。

words.enDefinition: To sign a document using digital means

examples.en: Can I sign electronically if I'm still abroad when the letter comes through?
examples.zh: 录用函发来时如果我还在国外，我可以「以电子方式签署」吗？

examples.en: The university let me sign electronically and then download the completed document from the portal.
examples.zh: 学校允许我「以电子方式签署」，然后从门户下载签好的文件。

words.enDefinition: A web link opening a document for signing

examples.en: The signing link opened the offer letter with the correct start date this time.
examples.zh: 这次「线上签署链接」打开的录用函上，到岗日期是对的。

examples.en: I requested a new signing link after the original one stopped working that morning.
examples.zh: 原来的链接那天早上失效了，我申请了新的「线上签署链接」。

words.enDefinition: A version of a contract prepared before signing

examples.en: The manager sent the draft contract for me to read before signing anything.
examples.zh: 经理先把「合同草案」发给我看，再让我签署文件。

examples.en: I noticed that the draft contract still gave the old address for the workplace.
examples.zh: 我发现「合同草案」里的工作地点还是旧地址。

words.enDefinition: A copy of a document without signatures

examples.en: I accidentally downloaded the unsigned copy instead of the file we had signed.
examples.zh: 我不小心下载了「未签字的副本」，没下载我们已经签好的文件。

examples.en: The unsigned copy was still attached to the original message from the library.
examples.zh: 图书馆最早发的那条消息里仍然附着「未签字的副本」。

words.enDefinition: The space provided for a signature

examples.en: I had to scroll down to see the signature field at the bottom of the page.
examples.zh: 我得向下滚动，才能看见页面最下面的「签名栏」。

examples.en: The portal highlighted the signature field when I tried to submit the completed document.
examples.zh: 我试着提交填好的文件时，门户高亮标出了「签名栏」。

words.enDefinition: The date a document is signed

examples.en: I entered the signing date next to my name on the last page.
examples.zh: 我在最后一页姓名旁边填了「签署日期」。

examples.en: I checked that the signing date matched the day the portal received the document.
examples.zh: 我确认了「签署日期」和门户收到文件的日期一致。

words.enDefinition: The date an agreement begins to apply

examples.en: The offer letter showed an effective date that differed from the day I signed it.
examples.zh: 录用函写的「生效日期」和我签署它的日期不同。

examples.en: Could you confirm the effective date for the new working hours in the agreement?
examples.zh: 您能确认协议里新工时的「生效日期」吗？

collocations: the effective date of an agreement

words.enDefinition: A brief description of the benefits offered

examples.en: The benefits summary showed which support was included with the weekend library role.
examples.zh: 「福利概览」列出了图书馆周末岗位包含哪些福利项目。

examples.en: I read the benefits summary before asking whether I could claim a travel allowance.
examples.zh: 我先读了「福利概览」，再询问能不能申请交通补贴。

collocations: a benefits summary for new staff

words.enDefinition: Approved time away from work with pay

examples.en: I checked which kinds of paid leave were listed for people working weekends.
examples.zh: 我查了给周末上班的人列出了哪些「带薪休假」。

examples.en: The manager pointed me to the page about paid leave before I accepted the offer.
examples.zh: 我接受录用通知之前，经理让我看介绍「带薪休假」的页面。

words.enDefinition: Time away from work allocated each year

examples.en: The staff booklet explained how to request annual leave after the first week.
examples.zh: 员工手册说明了第一周结束后怎么申请「年假」。

examples.en: I asked whether my annual leave could be taken during the university's reading week.
examples.zh: 我问能不能在学校的阅读周休「年假」。

words.enDefinition: Authorization to take requested time away from work

examples.en: The staff handbook explained who handles leave approval when the department manager is away.
examples.zh: 员工手册说明了部门经理不在时由谁负责「休假审批」。

examples.en: I asked how long leave approval usually takes when staff request a week off.
examples.zh: 我问员工申请休一周时，「休假审批」一般需要多久。

words.enDefinition: Official public holidays for which an employee receives pay

examples.en: The museum's benefits summary listed paid public holidays in a separate column from annual leave.
examples.zh: 博物馆的福利概览把「带薪公共假日」和年假分列在不同栏里。

examples.en: I asked which dates counted as paid public holidays at the branch I'd be joining.
examples.zh: 我问，我即将入职的分馆把哪些日期算作「带薪公共假日」。

collocations: a list of paid public holidays

words.enDefinition: Approved time away from work with pay during illness

examples.en: I read the section on paid sick leave before accepting the university's offer.
examples.zh: 接受学校的录用通知前，我读了「带薪病假」这一栏。

examples.en: The manager said that the offer summary explained paid sick leave for weekend staff.
examples.zh: 经理说，录用摘要说明了周末员工的「带薪病假」。

words.enDefinition: Pay received for a qualifying period of sickness

examples.en: I asked how sick pay would be calculated for staff working different hours each week.
examples.zh: 我问每周工时不同的员工，「病假工资」会怎么算。

examples.en: The staff booklet had a separate section on sick pay during the first year.
examples.zh: 员工手册单独介绍了入职第一年的「病假工资」。

words.enDefinition: A day off for personal matters

examples.en: I asked whether a personal day could cover an appointment that conflicted with my shift.
examples.zh: 我问能不能用一天「个人事务假」去赴一个和班次冲突的预约。

examples.en: The benefits guide explained how to request a personal day through the staff portal.
examples.zh: 福利指南解释了怎样通过员工门户申请「个人事务假」。

words.enDefinition: Paid leave taken on a date chosen by the employee

examples.en: The handbook says that I can use my floating holiday on a day I choose.
examples.zh: 手册说，在我选定的那天，可以休「可自选日期的带薪假」。

examples.en: I asked whether the floating holiday had to be taken before the academic year ended.
examples.zh: 我问「可自选日期的带薪假」是不是要在学年结束前休完。

words.enDefinition: Approved time away from work without pay

examples.en: I asked about unpaid leave because my course includes a short trip in June.
examples.zh: 我问了「无薪休假」的事，因为课程包含六月的一次短途出行。

examples.en: The department explained how to request unpaid leave for days outside my annual allowance.
examples.zh: 部门说明了超出年假额度的日子怎样申请「无薪休假」。

words.enDefinition: The amount of leave someone still has available

examples.en: The portal showed my leave balance after I booked two days off for exams.
examples.zh: 我因为考试请了两天假后，门户显示了我的「剩余休假额度」。

examples.en: I asked when my leave balance would first appear after starting the library job.
examples.zh: 我问在图书馆开始工作后，什么时候能第一次看到「剩余休假额度」。

words.enDefinition: The gradual buildup of leave over time

examples.en: The first page of the benefits guide explained leave accrual for people working weekends.
examples.zh: 福利指南第一页介绍了周末上班人员的「休假额度累积」方式。

examples.en: I asked when leave accrual would begin because my start date was moving.
examples.zh: 因为到岗日期要变动，我问什么时候开始「累积休假额度」。

words.enDefinition: A recurring annual period used to manage leave

examples.en: The leave year at my new job runs from September to the following August.
examples.zh: 我新工作的「休假额度计算年度」从九月持续到次年八月。

examples.en: I asked which leave year applied to the time off I had already booked.
examples.zh: 我问已预约的休假计入哪个「休假额度计算年度」。

collocations: the start of the leave year
the end of the leave year

words.zhGloss: 把未休假期结转到下一期
words.enDefinition: To move unused leave into a later period
acceptedZhAnswers: 把未休假期结转到下一期

examples.en: I asked whether staff could carry over leave from one year to the next.
examples.zh: 我问员工能不能「把未休假期结转到下一年」。

examples.en: The policy explained when we could carry over leave that we hadn't been able to use.
examples.zh: 政策介绍了什么时候可以「把没能休的假期结转到下一期」。

collocations: be allowed to carry over leave
carry over leave into the next year

words.enDefinition: A cash payment for unused leave

examples.en: The handbook explained when a leave payout could appear on an employee's final statement.
examples.zh: 手册说明了「未休假期折算款」什么时候可能出现在员工最后一份结算单上。

examples.en: I asked how the library recorded a leave payout if someone left before the summer.
examples.zh: 我问如果有人在暑假之前离职，图书馆会怎么记录「未休假期折算款」。

words.enDefinition: Time off given in exchange for extra hours worked

examples.en: The manager said the policy on time off in lieu was in the staff handbook.
examples.zh: 经理说，关于「加班后补休」的规定在员工手册里。

examples.en: I asked how to record time off in lieu after covering an extra evening shift.
examples.zh: 我问多顶了一个晚班后，该怎么登记「加班后的补休」。

words.enDefinition: Paid time off to care for a new child

examples.en: The offer's benefits sheet listed paid parental leave alongside the other kinds of leave.
examples.zh: 录用福利说明把「带薪育儿假」与其他休假类型列在一起。

examples.en: I asked where to find the details about paid parental leave in the handbook.
examples.zh: 我问手册里哪里可以找到「带薪育儿假」的详细说明。

words.enDefinition: Time off following the death of someone close

examples.en: The handbook listed bereavement leave separately from the standard annual leave allowance for staff.
examples.zh: 手册把「丧假」和员工标准年假额度分开列出。

examples.en: The manager explained who to contact about bereavement leave if the office was closed.
examples.zh: 经理解释了办公室关门时该联系谁申请「丧假」。

words.enDefinition: A paid day away from work for volunteering

examples.en: The library offered a paid volunteer day to staff who helped at local events.
examples.zh: 图书馆给协助本地活动的员工提供一个「带薪志愿服务日」。

examples.en: I asked whether I could book a paid volunteer day for the campus food drive.
examples.zh: 我问能不能申请一个「带薪志愿服务日」，去帮忙做校园食品募捐。

words.enDefinition: Whether someone meets the conditions for benefits

examples.en: I checked the page on benefits eligibility because I was offered a part-time role.
examples.zh: 因为我拿到的是兼职岗位的录用通知，我看了「福利资格」那一页。

examples.en: The adviser explained how working hours affected benefits eligibility for this particular library role.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了在这个图书馆岗位上，工时如何影响「福利资格」。

words.enDefinition: The date on which employment benefits begin

examples.en: The benefits start date in the guide was not the same as my first workday.
examples.zh: 指南上「开始享受福利的日期」和我第一天上班的日期不同。

examples.en: I asked whether changing my first shift would also change the benefits start date.
examples.zh: 我问改了第一班的时间，会不会也改动「开始享受福利的日期」。

words.enDefinition: Time before an employee's benefit eligibility begins

examples.en: The guide lists a benefits waiting period for some of the options it describes.
examples.zh: 指南给部分福利选项列了「福利等待期」。

examples.en: I checked when the benefits waiting period would end after receiving my updated start date.
examples.zh: 收到更新后的到岗日期后，我查了「福利等待期」什么时候结束。

collocations: the end of the benefits waiting period

words.enDefinition: Signing up to receive offered employment benefits

examples.en: The guide said benefits enrollment would open after my account appeared in the system.
examples.zh: 指南说，我的账户在系统里出现后，就会开放「员工福利登记」。

examples.en: I asked whether benefits enrollment could be completed on a phone before my first day.
examples.zh: 我问能不能在第一天上班前用手机完成「员工福利登记」。

words.enDefinition: Employment benefits that workers can choose among

examples.en: My offer mentioned flexible benefits and listed several options on the next page.
examples.zh: 录用通知提到了「可自选的员工福利」，并在下一页列出几个选项。

examples.en: I asked whether the flexible benefits also applied to people on the weekend schedule.
examples.zh: 我问上周末班的员工是否也能享受「可自选的员工福利」。

words.enDefinition: Health insurance arranged through an employer

examples.en: The offer included employer-sponsored health insurance, with the plan details in a separate attachment.
examples.zh: 录用通知包括「雇主提供的医疗保险」，具体方案另见附件。

examples.en: I asked when employer-sponsored health insurance would begin if I accepted the library's offer.
examples.zh: 我问如果接受图书馆的录用通知，「雇主提供的医疗保险」什么时候开始。

words.enDefinition: Money an employer pays toward an employee benefit

examples.en: The benefits summary listed the employer contribution beside the employee's share of the cost.
examples.zh: 福利概览把「雇主缴款」和员工自己承担的费用并排列出。

examples.en: I asked whether the employer contribution shown in the guide included the pension plan.
examples.zh: 我问指南上列出的「雇主缴款」包不包括养老金计划。

words.enDefinition: An employer payment linked to an employee's contribution

examples.en: The leaflet explained how the employer match would appear in the retirement account.
examples.zh: 传单解释了「雇主配缴款」会怎样显示在退休储蓄账户里。

examples.en: I asked where the rules for the employer match were listed in the benefits guide.
examples.zh: 我问福利指南哪里列出了「雇主配缴款」的规则。

words.enDefinition: A scheme providing income after retirement

examples.en: The offer summary linked to a page about the university's pension plan for staff.
examples.zh: 录用摘要附了一个页面链接，介绍学校教职工的「养老金计划」。

examples.en: I asked whether the pension plan listed in my letter was also for part-time staff.
examples.zh: 我问信中列出的「养老金计划」是否也适用于兼职员工。

words.enDefinition: Money toward travel costs incurred for work

examples.en: The offer included a travel allowance for visits to museums outside the city.
examples.zh: 录用通知包括去市外博物馆出差的「差旅补贴」。

examples.en: I asked whether the travel allowance covered the train fare between the two branches.
examples.zh: 我问「差旅补贴」是否能支付两个分馆之间的火车票。

words.enDefinition: An employer-provided benefit for travel to work

examples.en: The benefits guide listed a commuter benefit that covered part of my bus pass.
examples.zh: 福利指南列了一项可以负担部分公交月票费用的「通勤福利」。

examples.en: I asked whether the commuter benefit would still apply if I changed my work location.
examples.zh: 我问如果换了工作地点，「通勤福利」是否仍然适用。

collocations: sign up for a commuter benefit

words.enDefinition: Money provided toward meals connected with work

examples.en: The offer specified a meal allowance for shifts that finished after eight in the evening.
examples.zh: 录用通知写明，晚上八点之后结束的班次有「餐费补贴」。

examples.en: Could you confirm whether the meal allowance covers lunch during days in the other branch?
examples.zh: 您能确认去另一家分馆上班时，「餐费补贴」包不包括午餐吗？

words.enDefinition: Help with moving for a new job

examples.en: I asked whether relocation assistance covered a move from the other side of the city.
examples.zh: 我问从城市另一边搬家是否在「搬迁援助」范围内。

examples.en: The offer summary described relocation assistance separately from the salary for my new role.
examples.zh: 录用摘要把「搬迁援助」和我新岗位的薪资分开说明。

words.enDefinition: Money toward approved career learning activities

examples.en: The role included a professional development allowance that I could use for approved courses.
examples.zh: 这个岗位有「职业发展补贴」，我可以用来参加经批准的课程。

examples.en: I asked whether the professional development allowance would cover joining a library association.
examples.zh: 我问「职业发展补贴」能不能用来支付加入图书馆协会的费用。

words.enDefinition: Money an employer provides for well-being expenses

examples.en: The wellness allowance covered part of the cost of my local sports centre membership.
examples.zh: 这笔「身心健康补贴」承担了我加入本地体育中心的部分费用。

examples.en: I checked whether the wellness allowance was still included in the revised offer.
examples.zh: 我确认了修改后的录用通知里还有没有「身心健康补贴」。

words.zhGloss: 主动放弃参加福利计划
words.enDefinition: To choose not to receive offered benefits
acceptedZhAnswers: 主动放弃参加福利计划

examples.en: The portal showed where to opt out of benefits before I confirmed my choices.
examples.zh: 门户显示了确认选项之前可以在哪儿「主动放弃参加福利计划」。

examples.en: I asked whether I could opt out of benefits I already had through another plan.
examples.zh: 我问，其他计划已经为我提供的福利，能不能在这里「选择不参加」。

collocations: choose to opt out of benefits
be allowed to opt out of benefits
a form to opt out of benefits

words.enDefinition: A guide describing employee benefits and their conditions

examples.en: The benefits handbook explained how I could check my leave balance after starting work.
examples.zh: 「员工福利手册」解释了开始工作后怎样查看剩余休假额度。

examples.en: I saved the benefits handbook so I could read it before signing the offer letter.
examples.zh: 我保存了「员工福利手册」，准备签录用函前读一下。

words.enDefinition: A rule that unused allowances expire without carrying over

examples.en: I asked whether the use-it-or-lose-it policy applied to the volunteer day in the offer.
examples.zh: 我问录用通知里的志愿服务日是否适用「额度到期作废政策」。

examples.en: The use-it-or-lose-it policy was explained near the end of the staff benefits guide.
examples.zh: 员工福利指南快结尾的地方说明了「额度到期作废政策」。

collocations: be subject to a use-it-or-lose-it policy

words.enDefinition: Taking annual leave before earning the needed balance

examples.en: My new employer in Australia explained how annual leave in advance worked at the museum.
examples.zh: 我在澳大利亚的新雇主解释了博物馆的「预支年假」安排。

examples.en: I asked whether I could request annual leave in advance before the holiday I'd booked.
examples.zh: 我问能不能在已预订的假期之前申请「预支年假」。

collocations: an agreement for annual leave in advance

words.enDefinition: A break during which a worker continues to be paid

examples.en: I checked whether my afternoon shift included a paid rest break in the middle.
examples.zh: 我查了下午班中间有没有「带薪休息时段」。

examples.en: The working hours table listed a paid rest break separately from the lunch break.
examples.zh: 工时表把「带薪休息时段」和午休分开列了。

words.enDefinition: A sum available to spend on specified benefits

examples.en: The benefit allowance for this role was listed beside the options I could choose.
examples.zh: 我可以选择的项目旁边列出了这个岗位的「福利津贴额度」。

examples.en: I asked whether the benefit allowance could be used for both courses and memberships.
examples.zh: 我问「福利津贴额度」能不能同时用于课程和会员费。

words.enDefinition: The part of a benefit's cost paid by the worker

examples.en: The table listed the employee share and the amount paid by the employer.
examples.zh: 表格列出了「员工自付部分」和雇主支付的金额。

examples.en: I asked whether the employee share would come out of each month's pay.
examples.zh: 我问「员工自付部分」是不是从每个月的工资里扣。

collocations: the employee share of the cost

words.zhGloss: 已选的员工福利项目（美国）
words.enDefinition: An employee's formal choices among available benefits
acceptedZhAnswers: 已选的员工福利项目（美国）

examples.en: The U.S. university's portal let me review my benefit elections before confirming them online.
examples.zh: 那所美国大学的门户允许我在线确认前先查看「已选的员工福利项目」。

examples.en: The email said I could save a copy of my benefit elections for my records.
examples.zh: 邮件说，我可以保存一份「已选的员工福利项目」记录，方便以后查看。
